svg.text: EN: Describe what happens when the pressure increases.
MT SW: Eleza nini kutokea wakati shinikizo inaongezeka.
Refined SW: Eleza kinachotokea shinikizo linapoongezeka.
EN: A lot of data were collected during the field study.
MT SW: Nyingi data ilikusanywa wakati wa utafiti wa shamba.
Refined SW: Data nyingi zilikusanywa wakati wa utafiti wa uwandani.
EN: Draw a graph showing the relationship between mass and volume.
MT SW: Chora grafu inaonyesha uhusiano kati ya uzito na ujazo.
Refined SW: Chora grafu inayoonesha uhusiano kati ya massa na ujazo.
EN: Nutrients are absorbed through the small intestine.
MT SW: Virutubisho vinafyonzwa kupitia utumbo mdogo.
Refined SW: Virutubisho hufyonzwa kupitia utumbo mwembamba.
